Insert 16-bit values in the chosen CPU's byte order. All currently supported CPUs are little-endian.

directive.name: !wo
directive.description: Insert 16-bit values in the chosen CPU's byte order. All currently supported CPUs are little-endian.

directive.name: !word
directive.description: Insert 16-bit values in the chosen CPU's byte order. All currently supported CPUs are little-endian.

directive.name: !le16
directive.description: Insert 16-bit values in little-endian byte order.

directive.name: !be16
directive.description: Insert 16-bit values in big-endian byte order.
Insert 24-bit values in the chosen CPU's byte order. All currently supported CPUs are little-endian.

directive.name: !le24

directive.name: !be24
directive.description: Insert 24-bit values in big-endian byte order.
Insert 32-bit values in the chosen CPU's byte order. All currently supported CPUs are little-endian.

directive.name: !le32
directive.description: Insert 32-bit values in little-endian byte order.

directive.name: !be32
directive.description: Insert 32-bit values in big-endian byte order.

directive.name: !hex
directive.description: Insert byte values from pairs of hexadecimal digits. No prefix or separators are allowed, though spaces and tabs may be used between pairs.

directive.name: !h
directive.description: Insert byte values from pairs of hexadecimal digits. No prefix or separators are allowed, though spaces and tabs may be used between pairs.

directive.name: !fill
directive.description: Fill a given amount of memory with a value. If the value is omitted, zero is used.

directive.name: !fi
directive.description: Fill a given amount of memory with a value. If the value is omitted, zero is used.

directive.name: !skip
directive.description: Advance the program counter without starting a new segment.

directive.name: !align
directive.description: Fill memory until the program counter ANDed with the given value equals the target value. The optional fill value defaults to $ea, the 6502 NOP opcode.

directive.name: !convtab
directive.description: Choose the text conversion table used by string pseudo opcodes. Valid keywords are pet, raw, and scr, or a file name holding a 256-byte conversion table.

directive.name: !ct
directive.description: Choose the text conversion table used by string pseudo opcodes. Valid keywords are pet, raw, and scr, or a file name holding a 256-byte conversion table.

directive.name: !text
directive.description: Output the given strings using the current conversion table.

directive.name: !tx
directive.description: Output the given strings using the current conversion table.

directive.name: !pet
directive.description: Output the given strings using the PetSCII conversion table.

directive.name: !raw
directive.description: Output the given strings without any conversion.

directive.name: !scr
directive.description: Output the given strings using the C64 screen code conversion table.

directive.name: !scrxor
directive.description: Output the given strings using the C64 screen code conversion table, XORing each result with the given value.

directive.name: !to
directive.description: Set the output file name and format. Valid formats are cbm, plain, and apple. If the format is omitted, cbm is used.

directive.name: !source
directive.description: Assemble another source file, then continue with the current one.

directive.name: !src
directive.description: Assemble another source file, then continue with the current one.

directive.name: !binary
directive.description: Insert a binary file into the output, optionally limiting the size and skipping an initial offset.

directive.name: !bin
directive.description: Insert a binary file into the output, optionally limiting the size and skipping an initial offset.

directive.name: !zone
directive.description: Start a new zone for local symbols. Zones can be nested and may be given a block.

directive.name: !zn
directive.description: Start a new zone for local symbols. Zones can be nested and may be given a block.

directive.name: !symbollist
directive.description: Write a list of all global symbols to the given file after assembly is finished.

directive.name: !sl
directive.description: Write a list of all global symbols to the given file after assembly is finished.

directive.name: !if
directive.description: Conditionally assemble a block depending on a condition, with an optional else block.

directive.name: !ifdef
directive.description: Assemble a block only if the given symbol is already defined.

directive.name: !ifndef
directive.description: Assemble a block only if the given symbol is not yet defined.

directive.name: !for
directive.description: Assemble a block repeatedly, with a loop counter ranging from the start to the end value.

directive.name: !set
directive.description: Assign a value to a symbol even if it is already defined. Useful for loop counters.

directive.name: !do
directive.description: Assemble a block repeatedly while or until a condition holds. Conditions may appear before and/or after the block.

directive.name: !endoffile
directive.description: Stop processing the current source file.

directive.name: !eof
directive.description: Stop processing the current source file.

directive.name: !warn
directive.description: Emit a warning during assembly.

directive.name: !error
directive.description: Emit an error during assembly. No output file will be generated.

directive.name: !serious
directive.description: Emit a serious error and stop assembly immediately.

directive.name: !macro
directive.description: Define a macro. Parameters may be passed by value or, with a leading '~', by reference.

directive.name: !initmem
directive.description: Set the value used to fill gaps between segments in the output file.

directive.name: !xor
directive.description: XOR all subsequently output bytes with the given value. With a block, the previous value is restored afterwards.

directive.name: !pseudopc
directive.description: Assemble a block as if the program counter had the given value, for code that will be copied elsewhere before running.

directive.name: !cpu
directive.description: Select the target processor. Valid keywords include 6502, 6510, 65c02, r65c02, w65c02, 65816, 65ce02, 4502, and c64dtv2.

directive.name: !al
directive.description: Assume a long (16-bit) accumulator. Only valid for the 65816.

directive.name: !as
directive.description: Assume a short (8-bit) accumulator. Only valid for the 65816.

directive.name: !rl
directive.description: Assume long (16-bit) index registers. Only valid for the 65816.

directive.name: !rs
directive.description: Assume short (8-bit) index registers. Only valid for the 65816.

directive.name: !address
directive.description: Mark a block or symbol definition as containing addresses for the optional type check system.

directive.name: !addr
directive.description: Mark a block or symbol definition as containing addresses for the optional type check system.

directive.name: !cbm
directive.description: Obsolete. Use !convtab pet instead.

directive.name: !subzone
directive.description: Obsolete. Use !zone with a block instead.

directive.name: !sz
directive.description: Obsolete. Use !zone with a block instead.

directive.name: !realpc
directive.description: Obsolete. Use !pseudopc with a block instead.
